example.title: Beacon Marine Basin boatyard building on Eastern Wharf, Gloucester

brief: A working boatyard's main building on a timber wharf: a long two-and-a-half-storey white-shingled shed with a red base band and a grey gabled roof with dormers, 'BEACON MARINE BASIN' painted along its side, standing on a forest of piles over the tidal flats, with floating docks and dinghies alongside. Four photos. Older than 1970: New England boatyards' wharf buildings are pre-war. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
label: Boatyard
